quote: killing a minimum of 12 people, two of them children, and injuring roughly 2,800
correction: Fetch-tool rendering of Al Jazeera 18 Sept 2024; AP: 'At least 12 persons were killed and some 2,800 wounded'.

claim: Hezbollah and the Lebanese government blamed Israel
quote: Hezbollah and the Lebanese government blamed Israel

claim: Lebanon asked for a UN Security Council meeting
correction: Not found in any opened page (Al Jazeera 18-19 Sept 2024, AP/Tribune 19 Sept 2024). Needs a UN or news source.

quote: Final approval by the Israeli Government of the so-called E1 settlement plan in occupied East Jerusalem represents another grave and unlawful step to consolidate annexation
correction: OHCHR press release, 21 Aug 2025 (ReliefWeb, opened via curl).

claim: Smotrich said it would 'bury the idea of a Palestinian state'
quote: boasted that the project will “bury the idea of a Palestinian state,”
correction: HRW release (19 Aug 2026, reposted on ReliefWeb): 'Smotrich, in August 2025, boasted...'. Single source (HRW, an advocacy group) for the quote.

claim: September 2025 ceremony: Netanyahu declared 'There will be no Palestinian state'
quote: There will be no Palestinian state! This place is ours.
correction: HRW, 19 Aug 2026: 'At a signing ceremony for the project in September 2025, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu declared'.

claim: UN human rights office called approval an unlawful step to consolidate annexation
quote: another grave and unlawful step to consolidate annexation of the occupied West Bank

claim: E1 would cut links between East Jerusalem, Ramallah and Bethlehem and between northern and southern West Bank
quote: a nerve centre connecting the three major Palestinian cities of East Jerusalem, Ramallah and Bethlehem, as well as the north and south of the West Bank
correction: Also UN SG report via UNSCO, 28 Sep 2026 (https://reliefweb.int/report/occupied-palestinian-territory/report-secretary-general-implementation-un-security-council-resolution-2334-2016-delivered-ramiz-alakbarov-acting-special-coordinator-middle-east-peace-process-28-september-2026): 'which would effectively sever the connection between the northern and southern West Bank and further isolate East Jerusalem from the rest of the West Bank'.

claim: Tenders for 3,401 housing units published December 2025
quote: On December 9, 2025, the Israeli Construction and Housing Ministry published a call for tenders for the construction of the 3,401 housing units

claim: First tender for 1,234 units opened 18 August 2026
quote: The Israeli government on August 18, 2026, opened a new tender for the construction of 1,234 housing units
correction: Cross-check: UNSCO 28 Sep 2026 (https://reliefweb.int/report/occupied-palestinian-territory/report-secretary-general-implementation-un-security-council-resolution-2334-2016-delivered-ramiz-alakbarov-acting-special-coordinator-middle-east-peace-process-28-september-2026): tenders 'including for 1,234 units in the E1 area near Jerusalem'.

claim: Israeli groups and Bedouin residents challenged the plan in court
quote: The project was challenged in court by Israeli organizations PeaceNow, Bimkom, and Ir Amim together with Bedouin Palestinian residents.

claim: OCHA lists 18 Bedouin and herding communities affected by E1 and at risk of forcible transfer
quote: one of 18 Bedouin and herding communities affected by the E1 settlement plan and at risk of forcible transfer
correction: OCHA Humanitarian Situation Report, 2 Oct 2026, Annex 2 (Az Za'ayyem Bedouins entry). HRW says E1 would 'forcibly displace over 18 Bedouin communities'.

claim: From 11 March the government sealed the borders [parent second pass; supersedes earlier drop]
quote: Everyone arriving in Israel will be required to self-quarantine for 14 days to prevent the spread of coronavirus, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu says.
correction: BBC, 9 March 2020 (opened via curl with browser user-agent): Netanyahu announced a 14-day self-quarantine for all arrivals; Interior Minister Deri said it applied immediately to returning Israelis and 'to foreign citizens from Thursday' (12 March). Replace 'From 11 March ... sealed the borders' with 'From 9-12 March the government required 14-day quarantine for all arrivals, effectively closing entry to foreigners'.

claim: Date 28 August 2025: Israeli strike in Sanaa killed Houthi PM Ahmed al-Rahawi and several ministers
quote: Ahmed al-Rahawi was killed in a Thursday strike in Sanaa along with a number of ministers, the rebels said in a statement.
correction: NPR/AP, originally published 30 Aug 2025 (Thursday = 28 Aug). NPR page opened via curl (WebFetch timed out). AJ 30 Aug 2025: strike came 'four days after' the 24 Aug strikes.

claim: Strike targeted a meeting of Houthi officials
quote: targeted a meeting for Houthi leaders in a villa in Beit Baws
correction: Per three tribal leaders speaking to AP.

claim: Most senior Houthi official killed in the Israeli-US campaign
quote: He was the most senior Houthi official killed in the Israeli-U.S. campaign against the Iranian-backed rebels.

claim: Number of ministers killed (affected_populations note: Israeli media said PM and 12 ministers targeted)
quote: The Houthis did not specify how many other ministers were also killed in the Israeli attack.
correction: AJ: 'Israeli media reported on Friday that the Israeli army attacked the entire Houthi cabinet, including the prime minister and 12 other ministers' (unnamed sources). Summary's 'several ministers' is consistent; affected_populations 'killed: 11' is not supported by any opened source as a total for 28 Aug (it appears to be 10 from 24 Aug + al-Rahawi) and should be labelled as such.

claim: 24 August Israeli strikes on Sanaa killed 10 and wounded more than 90 (health officials)
quote: At least 10 people were killed and 92 others were injured in the attacks, according to health officials.

claim: The 24 Aug strikes followed a Houthi missile the IDF described as carrying cluster munitions
quote: described as the first cluster bomb the rebels had launched at it since 2023
correction: NPR/AP: 'The Aug. 24 strike came three days after the Houthis launched a ballistic missile toward Israel that its military described as the first cluster bomb...'.

claim: The Houthis vowed revenge
quote: We shall take vengeance, and we shall forge from the depths of wounds a victory
correction: Mahdi al-Mashat, chairman of the Supreme Political Council.

claim: September: Israeli strikes on Sanaa and al-Jawf killed more than 40, including journalists and children
quote: Earlier this month, Israeli strikes on Sanaa and the northern province of al-Jawf killed more than 40 people
correction: Sentence continues 'including journalists and children.' (AJ, 25 Sep 2025). Same article: further 24-25 Sep Sanaa strikes killed two and wounded 48 per Houthi-affiliated media.

claim: A Houthi drone wounded 22 people in Eilat (September 2025)
quote: following a drone attack on Eilat that wounded 22 people
correction: NBC News; photo caption dates the Eilat drone attack to 24 Sept 2025.

claim: 8 February 2026: security cabinet approved measures expanding Israeli civil authority in the West Bank, incl. parts of Areas A and B
quote: On 8 February, the Israeli cabinet approved a series of measures that would expand Israeli civil authority in the occupied West Bank
correction: UNSCO/SG 2334 briefing, 24 Mar 2026 (opened via curl): '...including in parts of Areas A and B'. OCHA #358 (19 Feb 2026) identifies the body as the Israeli Security Cabinet.

claim: Opening land registries and easing land purchases by Israelis
quote: these include de-classifying West Bank land registries, removing certain restrictions on land transactions
correction: OCHA #358; SG report: measures 'would also remove regulatory barriers on land acquisition and construction by Israelis'.

claim: Transferring planning powers in Hebron, incl. at the Ibrahimi Mosque / Tomb of the Patriarchs, to Israeli authorities
quote: transfer of Hebron municipal authorities, such as construction permits in the Ibrahimi Mosque/Tomb of the Patriarchs, to Israeli authorities

claim: 15 February: about NIS 244 million to resume land registration in Area C
quote: On 15 February, the Israeli Government approved a plan to resume land registration processes in Area C of the occupied West Bank and allocated some 244 million shekels
correction: Approx. USD 78 million.

claim: UN Secretary-General warned the measures erode prospects for a two-state solution
quote: recent measures authorized by the Israeli security cabinet in the West Bank further erode prospects for a two-State solution
correction: SG statement of 9 Feb 2026 (OCHA #358).

claim: ...and could dispossess Palestinians of their property
quote: could lead to the dispossession of Palestinians of their property and risks expanding Israeli control over land in the area.
correction: Attribution/target: per OCHA #358 this was the Secretary-General's statement of 16 Feb 2026 about the 15 Feb decision to resume land registration in Area C, not about the 8 Feb cabinet measures. Reword: 'the Secretary-General warned on 9 February that the measures erode prospects for a two-state solution, and on 16 February that Area C land registration could dispossess Palestinians of their property'.

claim: UN called the 'creeping annexation' unlawful
quote: The creeping annexation of the West Bank is unlawful, has no legal effect, and must stop.
correction: UN SG 2334 report delivered by UNSCO, 28 Sep 2026 (opened via curl).
